summary: Everything this skill needs before it can do anything. Read by both `kdocs_kit.py doctor` (report) and `kdocs_kit.py setup` (install). Single source of truth -- the two commands cannot drift apart, and tests enforce that.

requirements.title: Python 3.7+
requirements.why: This skill is a single Python script. It uses the standard library only -- there are no pip packages to install, which is why there is no requirements.txt.

install.reason: Installing a language runtime is the user's call, not a skill's.

manual.windows: Tick 'Add python.exe to PATH' during install. python.org builds provide `python`, not `python3` -- use `python` or `py -3`.

requirements.title: kdocs-cli (official WPS binary)
requirements.why: Every action is executed by the official CLI. This skill never talks to the WPS API directly -- it only wraps the CLI.

install.note: We fetch and run WPS's own installer rather than reimplementing it. It resolves your OS/arch, downloads from the official CDN, and verifies SHA-256 against checksums.txt. We do not redistribute the binary. The installer script itself is pinned by commit and checked against the SHA-256 below before it runs.

manual.all: Install the official kdocs skill from https://www.kdocs.cn/latest (avatar menu -> 金山文档Skill), which ships the same installer.

verify.note: We execute this script, so we verify it before running. Pinned to a commit, not a branch: a moving ref means the bytes we execute could change under us. Bump both the ref and these hashes together, deliberately.

requirements.title: Official `kdocs` skill (reference docs for raw passthrough)
requirements.why: This wrapper covers ~10 everyday commands. The other ~200 official actions are reached through `raw`, and their parameter docs live in the official skill's references/. Without it, `raw` still runs but you have to know the parameters yourself. Missing it does not break anything this skill wraps -- it only means you supply raw parameters yourself.

install.reason: The upstream repo declares no license (no LICENSE file, GitHub reports license: null), so its files cannot be bundled or redistributed here. Install it yourself from the copyright holder.

manual.all: Open https://www.kdocs.cn/latest -> avatar menu -> 金山文档Skill, or fetch https://github.com/kdocs-app/kdocs-skill into `.claude/skills/kdocs/`.

requirements.title: Network access to WPS
requirements.why: All document operations are cloud calls. A corporate proxy that blocks wps.cn will make every command fail in a way that looks like a bug in this skill.

install.reason: Network policy is not something a skill should change.

manual.all: Allow api.wps.cn and www.kdocs.cn through your proxy/firewall.

requirements.title: Claude Code 2.1.129+
requirements.why: `skillOverrides` only takes effect from this version. On older versions the official kdocs skill wins trigger matches and this wrapper's guardrails are bypassed.

install.reason: Upgrading the host agent is the user's call.

requirements.title: skillOverrides entry for the official skill
requirements.why: Both skills answer to the same words. Without this, the official one can take the turn and none of this wrapper's guardrails (no-overwrite, download verification, scope prompts) apply.

install.note: Merged into your existing settings; other keys are preserved. The official skill stays usable by hand as /kdocs.

requirements.title: A personal WPS account (not an enterprise one)
requirements.why: The Skill Hub token exchange is gated to personal accounts server-side. Enterprise accounts get HTTP 403 (code 403001) on every call, and no client-side change can work around it.

install.reason: Only a human can log in.

manual.all: Run `python scripts/kdocs_kit.py login` and approve in the browser, or paste a token from https://www.kdocs.cn/latest with `kdocs_kit.py set-token`.
